title: Review of c03 Allee no-turnover finding: both key arms reproduced on fresh seed 1; Supported
summary: Ran world_wb1.py and world_lowc0.py unchanged on seed 1 (150 frames x 800 steps, T=2400, 128^2) and the author's turnover.py. wb1 (higher unstructured catalyst, K=1): bodies 21 -> 41 by t~480 with 18 splits and 0 deaths, then 0 deaths, 0 splits and 0 nucleations in every later window to t=2400 (author seed 0: 28 -> 43, then static). lowc0 (noise-level catalyst): 21 -> 0 bodies by t~480, the catalyst never ignites (author: 28 -> 0). The Allee threshold therefore gives either extinction or a frozen population, with no stationary turnover, as reported.

observations.D: turnover_seed1.txt: wb1 18 splits then 0 events for t>480; lowc0 21 -> 0 bodies, 24 deaths, then empty

verdicts.limitation: wb2 and F=0.02 arms not rerun; one fresh seed; a negative result over the tested K, kc, c0 and F values only.
